title: Myles Garrett's first Rams training camp practice "definitely lived up to" expectations

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Myles Garrett's first Rams training camp practice "definitely lived up to" expectations
sources.description: The Rams weren't in full pads for Sunday's training camp practice, but they had their full squad on the field and that gave them a sense of how things will look with Myles Garrett at defensive end in 2026.
